Cautious Review third-party notices
===================================

open-greenhouse-mcp — MIT adaptations
--------------------------------------
Source repository: https://github.com/benmonopoli/open-greenhouse-mcp
Pinned source commit: 966fb2f36877dd62b14e924b9a7e1983ef88d11f
Copyright (c) 2026 Ben Monopoli

Adapted source files and exact source blob IDs are recorded in
UPSTREAM.json. The sequential batch/result-accounting pattern in
src/greenhouse_mcp/harvest/batch.py (blob
c0523a6881d82ccc739cd98b97fc69a47dea75d9) is adapted in src/batch.ts.
Additional 0.3.0 adaptations from client.py, harvest/applications.py,
harvest/attachments.py, harvest/job_stages.py, and
harvest/rejection_reasons.py are used in src/harvest.ts and src/identity.ts.
The adaptations cover general request handling and Harvest lookup/action
patterns. The upstream v1/v2 Basic-auth transport and request bodies are not
used; the live adapter is rebuilt for Harvest v3 OAuth Bearer requests and
v3 actions. Cautious Review adds its own identity checks, bounded/restricted
transport, reviewed plans, durable intent/receipts, read-after-write
reconciliation, and uncertain-write safeguards. The MIT license below applies
to these adapted portions.

Bundled browser libraries and model
-----------------------------------
PDF.js 5.4.624 — Mozilla Foundation; Apache-2.0. Bundled browser files are
unmodified. Full license is shipped as vendor/PDFJS-LICENSE.txt.

Transformers.js 3.8.1 — Hugging Face; Apache-2.0. Full license is shipped as
vendor/TRANSFORMERS-LICENSE.txt.

@huggingface/jinja 0.5.10 — Hugging Face; MIT. Included in the bundled
Transformers.js browser module. Full license is shipped as
vendor/JINJA-LICENSE.txt.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 — Microsoft; MIT. Full
license and dependency notices are shipped as vendor/ONNX-LICENSE.txt and
vendor/ONNX-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.

Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, revision
751bff37182d3f1213fa05d7196b954e230abad9 — Apache-2.0 as declared in the
pinned model metadata. The quantized ONNX file and tokenizer assets are
unmodified. The official Apache-2.0 license text is shipped as
models/minilm/LICENSE from MiniLM-LICENSE.txt (official text:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt); model revision, file URLs,
and SHA-256 values are in MODEL.json. The base model-card snapshot is retained
in MiniLM-BASE-CARD.md.
